## Services

- [Emergency Locksmith](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/emergency-locksmith): 24/7 emergency lockout response. Average 20–30 minute arrival in Sanford. Starting at $75. Available every day including holidays.
- [Residential Locksmith](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/residential-locksmith): Home lock installation, rekeying, repair, and smart lock upgrades. Starting at $65.
- [Commercial Locksmith](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/commercial-locksmith): Business security solutions, access control, master key systems. Licensed for commercial work.
- [Automotive Locksmith](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/automotive-locksmith): Car lockouts, transponder key programming, key fob replacement. All vehicle makes and models.
- [Car Lockout](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/car-lockout): Unlock your vehicle non-destructively. 20–30 minute response. Starting at $75.
- [House Lockout](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/house-lockout): Residential lockout service. Non-destructive entry. Available 24/7.
- [Business Lockout](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/business-lockout): Commercial lockout response for offices, retail, and industrial properties.
- [Lock Rekeying](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/rekeying): Rekey existing locks to new keys. More affordable than full replacement. Recommended after moving or losing a key.
- [Lock Repair](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/lock-repair): Repair damaged, worn, or malfunctioning locks on doors, vehicles, and commercial properties.
- [Lock Installation](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/lock-installation): Professional installation of deadbolts, knob locks, and high-security locks.
- [Key Duplication](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/key-duplication): Duplicate standard, high-security, and restricted keys on-site.
- [Car Key Replacement](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/car-key-replacement): Replace lost or damaged car keys including transponder keys, smart keys, and key fobs.
- [Smart Lock Installation](https://dcerdalocksmith.com/services/smart-lock-installation): Install and program smart locks, keypad deadbolts, and WiFi-enabled access systems.
